paite: Huai nung in Pathian in Mosi kiang ah, “TOUPA kiang ah hong tou in, nang leh Aaron, Nadab leh Abihu leh Israel upate lak a sawmsagihte, gamlapi a pan in Pathian bia un.
heading: Thukhun Hihkip Ahi
english: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

paite: Mosi kia TOUPA kiang ah ahong pai ding, himahleh amau ahong pai nai louh ding uh ahi. Mite leng amah toh ahong hohtouh louh ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Moses alone shall come near to Yahweh, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

paite: Mosi ahong pai a, TOUPA thute leh vaihawmna tengteng mite ahilhta hi. Mite'n aw kituak in adawng ua, "TOUPA'N agen thu tengteng ka hih ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which Yahweh has spoken will we do.”

paite: TOUPA thu tengteng Mosi in agelh a, zingsang in beltak in athou a, tang nuai ah maitam abawl a, Israel nam sawm-le-nih dungzui in, khuam sawm-le-nih aphut hi.
english: Moses wrote all Yahweh’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

paite: Ama'n Israel suante lak a tangvalte asawl a, amau TOUPA kiang ah halmang thillat leh lemna thillat in bawngtalte alan uhi.
english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in bawngtalte sisan kimkhat ala a, kuangdai sung ah akoih a; maitam tung ah asisan kimkhat atheh hi.
english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

paite: Thukhun Laibu ala a, mite zak in asim hi. Mite'n, "TOUPA'N agen tengteng hih in athu ka mang ding uhi," achi uhi.
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that Yahweh has said, and be obedient.”

paite: Mosi in sisan ala a mite tung ah atheh a, "Thukhun sisan en un, hiai thu tengteng thu a TOUPA'N akhun," achi hi.
english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”

paite: Mosi, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu leh Israel Upa sawmsagihte apaitou ua
english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

paite: Israel' Pathian ava mu uhi. Akhepek nuai ah sapphir a bawl hileh kilawm leh van bang a siang a-om hi.
english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

paite: Himahleh Israel suante lak a upate dou in Pathian in atung uah akhut alik kei hi. Amau leng Pathian mu napi in hingdam a om in ne in adawn uhi.
english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Tang ah ka kiang ah hong tou inla, huai ah om in. Suangpekte a ka gelhsa dan leh thupiakte ka hon pe ding; amaute na sinsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
heading: Sinai Tang Tung Ah Mosi
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

paite: Mosi leh amah huhpa Joshua adingkhia ua, Pathian tang ah ahohtou uhi.
english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

paite: Upate kiang ah, na kiang ua ka hong kik nawn masiah uh hiai ah hon ngak un. "Ngai un, Aaron leh Hur na ompih uhi. Mi kuapeuh in thubuai bangpeuh gen ding na neih uleh, amah akiang uah hong hoh hen," achi hi.
english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

paite: Tang ah Mosi ahohtou a, meipi in tang akhuhta hi.
english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

paite: Sinai Tang tung ah TOUPA thupina a-om a, meipi in ni guk sung akhuh hi. Ani sagih ni in meipi lak a kipan Mosi asamta hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

paite: Tang vum tung a TOUPA thupina, Israel suante muh in kangmang thei meikuang bang ahi.
english: The appearance of Yahweh’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

paite: Meipi lak ah Mosi alutta a, tang ah ava hohtou hi. Mosi tang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ava omta hi.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
